description: Create a secret. secretValue is a JSON object string of 1-100 key/value pairs (≤10,000 bytes); rotationTargets names the keys that rotation replaces. Use dryRun=true to preview.

autoRotationPeriod.description: Rotation period in days (1-730, default 90) — required when autoRotationYN=Y

autoRotationYN.description: Enable automatic rotation (Y) or not (N, default)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without creating

keyIsolation.description: Which Secret Manager host to call: 'global' (default) for secrets encrypted with a KMS global key (secretmanager.apigw.ntruss.com); 'regional' for secrets encrypted with a KMS region-isolated key (ocapi-kr.ncloud.com/secretmanager — the only option in the JPN region)

kmsBoundaryType.description: KMS key isolation: GLOBAL or ISOLATED (new keys support ISOLATED only)

kmsKeyTag.description: KMS key tag (see ncloud_secret_list_protection_keys) — required when protectionKeyType=USER_MANAGED_KEY

protectionKeyType.description: Protection key: DEFAULT (service key) or USER_MANAGED_KEY (your KMS key)

rotationTargets.description: Keys of secretValue that rotation replaces (at least one)

secretName.description: Secret name (3-15 chars: letters, digits, '-', '_'; starts with a letter)

secretType.description: Secret type (BASIC is the only valid value)

secretValue.description: Secret value as a JSON object string, e.g. '{"password":"..."}' (1-100 key/value pairs, ≤10,000 bytes)

triggerId.description: Rotation trigger ID (see ncloud_secret_list_triggers) — required when autoRotationYN=Y

name: ncloud_secret_create_secret
